{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\nColumns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("\nFirst 5 rows:\n", df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("\nNumber of duplicate patient_id:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())
print("\nUnique patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for sample_seq > 1 (re-tests)
print("\nNumber of patients with multiple sample_seq:", (df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique() > 1).sum())

# Check assay_batch units
print("\nUnique assay_batch values:", df['assay_batch'].unique())
print("\nSample of biomarker_final by assay_batch:", df.groupby('assay_batch')['biomarker_final'].describe())"}
